page_title: Flutter & Firebase Course - Build a Full Stack Instagram Clone

summary.title: Flutter & Firebase Course - Build a Full Stack Instagram Clone
summary.one_liner: You learn to build a responsive Instagram-style app in Flutter with Firebase handling auth, data storage, and images, following a chaptered video course.
keywords: how to build instagram clone with flutter
takeaways: Set up Firebase in a Flutter project and use it for sign-up and login
Build responsive login, signup, feed, add-post, comments, search, and profile screens
: Store post, comment, and like data in Firestore and display it in the UI
: Persist auth state and manage user data within the app
: Implement features such as selecting images, deleting posts, and following users
summary.summary: This is a long freeCodeCamp.org video course (about 6 hours 50 minutes by the chapter list) that builds an Instagram clone with Flutter and Firebase. The chapters walk through app theming, a responsive layout, Firebase setup, email sign-up and login, persisted auth state, modelling user data, and state management. Later sections cover the bottom app bar, adding posts with image selection, storing and displaying feed posts, like animations, comments, deleting posts, search, profiles, following users, and signing out. The page text is mainly the video's chapter list and sidebar, so the exact code and tooling details are not visible here.
